transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, it's really nice to meet you too, Doctor. Thank you so much for taking the time to see me. 

Um, well, I guess I'm mostly here because of some stress at work. I hope it's okay to talk about that? I'm a transportation inspector, and... well, I really don't want to sound like a complainer or anything, but ever since I won this county safety award a little while back, things have just been really tense. 

It's like... I don't know, it seems like certain people at work have been twisting my inspection reports. And they keep asking these really pointed budget questions, almost like they're trying to make me look crooked? I mean, my supervisor tells me it's just a normal review, and I always try to be a team player and listen to him, but... it just really feels like there's this coordinated effort going on behind the scenes to discredit me. 

Does that make sense? I mean, it's normal to feel overwhelmed when people are coming at your reputation like that, right? I just want to make sure I'm looking at this the right way.
Do you think it’s possible you might be mistaken about your coworkers coordinating against you?

I mean... I really, really wish I was mistaken. I know how it probably sounds, and I'd hate for you to think I'm just some difficult employee who can't take feedback. I always try to see the best in my team. 

But... well, I just can't ignore what's happening right in front of me. I try so hard to believe my supervisor when he says it's just a normal review, because I really respect him, but I can just tell there is a coordinated effort to discredit me. The way they twist the exact words on my inspection reports, and those budget questions... they aren't normal questions. They're just so pointed, like they're setting a trap to make me look crooked ever since I brought home that safety award. 

I'm trying to be reasonable about it, I really am. But when you see the same people doing it over and over... it's hard to be mistaken about that, right? I hope I'm not sounding too defensive or unreasonable. I just want to do my job well and clear my name. Am I explaining that okay?
If your supervisor showed you clear proof that no one was altering your reports, would you believe it?

I... gosh, I mean, I really want to believe him. I try so hard to be agreeable and just go with what he says. If he sat me down and showed me some kind of proof... I'd look at it, I promise I would. I'm not trying to be stubborn. 

But... well, I just don't know how he could prove that, you know? Because I've seen the reports after they've been filed, and the words are just... twisted. It's subtle, but it's there. And those budget questions keep happening. I know he says it's just a normal review, and I really don't want to make waves or be a problem for him, but... it's just so obvious to me that there's this coordinated effort to discredit me. Ever since that safety award, it's like they want to make me look crooked. 

I'd want to believe the proof, I really would. But... wouldn't it be more likely that they're just hiding it from him, too? I mean, that makes sense, doesn't it? I hope I'm not sounding too paranoid or anything. I just want to be honest with you about how it feels.
Do you believe for certain that your coworkers are coordinating against you?

I... yes. I mean, I don't want to sound like I'm making a big deal out of nothing, or like I'm being difficult. I really try to get along with everyone. But... yes, I am certain. 

I just... I see it happening. The way my inspection reports get twisted, and those budget questions that are just so pointed... it's all just to make me look crooked because of that county safety award. I know my supervisor says it's just a normal review, and I hate feeling like I'm disagreeing with him because he's a good guy, but... I can just tell. I know there's a coordinated effort to discredit me. 

I'm sorry, I know that probably sounds terrible, and I really hope you don't think less of me for saying it. I just... I have to be honest about what I'm seeing, right? That's what you need me to do?
How long have you been certain that your coworkers are coordinating against you?

Well... gosh, I guess it's been about a year now. Yeah, right around a year. 

It all really started right after I got recognized for that county safety initiative. I was so proud of that, and I thought everyone else would be happy for me too, you know? But that's when I started noticing the little things... the changes to my reports and those weird questions. 

I really tried to just brush it off at first, because I didn't want to be the guy who complains or causes drama in the office. I always try to be a good team player, and I'd hate for you to think I'm holding onto a grudge or anything like that. But it's just been going on for a whole year now, and it just got too hard to ignore. 

Does that timeline make sense to you? I hope I'm giving you the right information, I just want to make sure I'm answering your questions the best I can.
Before this started at work, have you generally found it hard to trust other people?

Oh, no, not at all. I... well, I've always prided myself on being a pretty trusting guy, actually. I really like people, and I always try to see the best in them, you know? Before all this stuff at work started, I never really had any problems trusting anyone. I usually get along great with folks. 

I really hope you don't think I'm just... I don't know, someone who goes around suspecting people all the time. Because that's not me at all. It's just this one specific situation with the reports that's been so... confusing. I just want you to know I'm usually a really easygoing person. Is it okay that I'm just experiencing this at work? I really don't want to give you the wrong impression about how I usually am.
